name: OmaWhats
author: megamvb
description: OmaWhats, a basic WhatsApp client for the Omarchy shell, built on whatsmeow. Text, replies, reactions, photos and files (sent and received). The daemon (omawhatsd) only runs while you switch it on; switched off, stored conversations stay readable.

barWidget.description: WhatsApp glyph with the unread count. Click for the power switch, pairing QR, latest chats and a button to open the client in a normal window; right-click opens the full-screen client; middle-click turns the daemon on or off.

schema.label: Chats in the panel
schema.description: How many recent chats the bar panel lists.

schema.label: Show the unread count in the bar
schema.description: Turn off to show the icon only.

schema.label: Notify new messages
schema.description: Applies from the next time OmaWhats is turned on.

schema.label: Download photos, stickers and GIFs automatically
schema.description: When a chat is opened with OmaWhats on. Videos, audio and documents download only when clicked.

schema.label: Send read receipts
schema.description: Blue ticks when a chat is opened. Applies from the next time OmaWhats is turned on.
